authority: docs/cameraanalysis/03-domain-contracts.md N6 — source of truth; this file is a machine-readable projection, not a rename of SemanticActionType
not_a_stable_contract: Stable v3 is not declared until C01 conformance. No entry may light up live CORRECT before its qualificationRef exists.

state_semantics.CORRECT: exactly one activeAction; other states carry none
state_semantics.SELECT_SUBJECT: non-empty real selectionCandidates; other states carry an empty list; missing target => ABSTAIN/no_subject, never an empty picker
state_semantics.KEEP: positive evidence for the selected target AND no active forbidding condition; never a substitute for missing data
state_semantics.WAIT: only a temporarily removable waiting condition
state_semantics.ABSTAIN: unsupported or insufficient signal; never a quality verdict

review_semantics.desired_is_comparison_not_instruction: in review a desired field is a comparison in text/selector, never an instruction to fix
review_semantics.action_proposal: keeps every Action field except baseline; adds admissibility, reasonCodes, alternativeGroupID? (N6.2:755)
review_semantics.qualification_ref_rule: qualificationRef is required only when admissibility=qualified; it is absent for needs_user_input/unsupported (N6.2:755)
review_semantics.scope_rule: scope=next_capture, except select_capture_moment where scope=now means choosing the reviewed shot (N6.2:755)
review_semantics.pre_admission: before admission a proposal is a hypothesis with conditional text and no executable arrow (N6.2:755)
review_semantics.live_projection: only a qualified proposal, after re-analysis of the current frame, projects into a future live episode (N6.2:755)
review_semantics.review_has_no_active_action: when context.phase=review there is no decision.activeAction; findings/suggestions/comparisons live in ReviewReport; state=KEEP on positive confirmation, otherwise ABSTAIN with a reason — review is never masked as live CORRECT (N6.2:755)
review_semantics.alternative_group: incompatible proposals share one alternativeGroupID and are never presented as sequential steps; the ordered list is a discussion plan, not an auto-action queue (N6.2:757)
review_semantics.review_report_shape: ReviewReport{coverage, findingRefs, suggestions:ActionProposal[0...3], comparisons:MediaComparison[]}; it does not open a live episode (N6.2:755)
